text: 1. Passport scan copy (the information page of the passport, it is recommended to be in JPG or PNG format, or in PDF format); 2. Applicants who have already studied or worked in China are required to submit a scanned copy of their visa or residence permit in China at the same time. 3. Recent personal ID photo (2-inch ID photo in electronic format. It is recommended to be in JPG or PNG format); 4. Scanned copies of the complete high school transcript (if you are currently enrolled in university, please also provide the transcript of the courses you have completed at the university); 5. Scanned copy of high school graduation certificate (For fresh graduates, a pre-graduation certificate can be provided first. The expected graduation date should be earlier than August 31, 2025; During the registration process, the original graduation certificate must be verified and a copy must be submitted). 6. Language proficiency proof materials (such as HSK certificates, etc.); 7. Students applying for art-related majors such as music, dance, performance, film and television, and fine arts are required to submit their personal works or performance videos. 8. One to two recommendation letters; 9. The "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" issued by the hospital; 10. Certificate of No Criminal Record (provided by the public security bureau or the school of your education); 11. Asset proof (bank deposit certificate of no less than 5000 US dollars in the name of the applicant or the applicant's parents); 12. For those under the age of 18, a guarantee letter from a guardian is required;
